title: Old Testament Review Night
welcome: Join on your phone with the room code.
Answer on your phone, not out loud.
Points get bigger every round, and the finale lets you wager.

rounds.title: Quick Quiz
rounds.intro: Fifteen questions on the scriptures we've studied.
rules: A question and four choices appear on the screen. Pick one on your phone.
The clock starts after the question is read aloud.
A correct answer scores. A faster correct answer scores a little more.

questions.q: Which scripture says “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart”?
questions.note: Proverbs 3:5–6. “…and he shall direct thy paths.”

questions.q: Which scripture says “Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil”?
Which scripture says “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow”?
Which scripture says “Choose you this day whom ye will serve”?
Which scripture asks “Who shall stand in his holy place?”
questions.note: Psalm 24:3–4. “He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart.”

questions.q: Which scripture says “How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
questions.note: Genesis 39:9. Joseph's answer to Potiphar's wife.

questions.q: Which scripture says “a marvellous work and a wonder”?
questions.note: Isaiah 29:13–14. The phrase is in verse 14.

questions.q: Which scripture says “Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows”?
Which scripture says “Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse”?
Which scripture says “call the sabbath a delight”?
Which scripture says “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee”?
questions.note: Jeremiah 1:4–5. “…I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.”

questions.q: Which scripture says “I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel”?
Which scripture says “take thee one stick… and they shall become one in thine hand”?
questions.note: Ezekiel 37:15–17. The Bible and the Book of Mormon.

questions.q: Which scripture says the God of heaven will “set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”?
Which scripture says the Lord “revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets”?
Which scripture says Elijah will “turn the heart of the fathers to the children”?
Which scripture says “Thou shalt have no other gods before me”?
Which scripture says “God created man in his own image”?
Which scripture says “a man… shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one”?
Which scripture says “This is my work and my glory—to bring to pass the immortality and eternal life of man”?
Which scripture says the people “were of one heart and one mind”?
questions.note: Moses 7:18. The people of Zion, with no poor among them.

questions.q: Which scripture says Abraham's seed would “bear this ministry and Priesthood unto all nations”?
questions.note: Abraham 2:9–11. The phrase is in verse 9.

questions.q: Which scripture says we “were organized before the world was”?
Maya's friends want her to watch a movie with content she knows isn't right. Which scripture helps her most?
questions.note: Genesis 39:9. Joseph fled temptation and said sin is against God. Isaiah 5:20 and Joshua 24:15 also fit.

questions.q: Ethan made a serious mistake and wonders whether Jesus Christ can forgive him. Which scripture helps him most?
questions.note: Isaiah 1:18. “…they shall be as white as snow.”

questions.q: Ava is anxious about choosing classes and a future career. Which scripture helps her most?
questions.note: Proverbs 3:5–6. Trust in the Lord, and he shall direct thy paths.

questions.q: Caleb feels invisible at school and wonders whether his life has any purpose. Which scripture helps him most?
questions.note: Moses 1:39. God's work and glory is our immortality and eternal life. Abraham 3:22–23 and Genesis 1:26–27 also fit.

questions.q: Liam asks, “Why would anyone need a prophet today?” Which scripture helps most?
questions.note: Amos 3:7. The Lord reveals His secrets to His servants the prophets. Ezekiel 3:16–17 and Isaiah 29:13–14 also fit.

questions.q: Sam asks why Sunday should feel different from the other days of the week. Which scripture helps most?
questions.note: Isaiah 58:13–14. Call the sabbath a delight.

questions.q: Jordan's friend asks why he pays ten percent of his income to the Church. Which scripture helps most?
questions.note: Malachi 3:8–10. The Lord promises to open the windows of heaven.

questions.q: Riley feels like no one understands the pain they carry. Which scripture teaches that the Savior carried our griefs?
Sophie wonders whether God knew her before she was born. Which scripture helps most?
Lucas wonders how the Lord warns His people of danger. Which scripture teaches that a prophet is like a watchman?
Zoe's friend says the Bible is enough and we don't need the Book of Mormon. Which scripture shows the two working together?
Amos 3:7 says the Lord reveals His secrets to:
Isaiah 58:6–7 describes the blessings of:
Malachi 3:8–10 describes the blessings of:
Isaiah 58:13–14 teaches how to treat:
choices: The tenth part of your income

questions.q: In Ezekiel 37:15–17, the two sticks that become one represent:
choices: The Bible and the Book of Mormon

questions.q: Daniel 2:44–45 foretold a kingdom that would:
choices: Be given to the kings of the earth

When Moroni first visited Joseph Smith in 1823, he began by quoting from this prophet:

questions.q: In 1828 Martin Harris showed characters from the gold plates to a scholar. This fulfilled a prophecy in:
What is the most important skill in seeking personal revelation?
choices: Learning to recognize the Holy Ghost

questions.q: Elder Ronald A. Rasband said the Spirit most often communicates to us:
questions.note: From the Acquiring Spiritual Knowledge lesson.

questions.q: When you have gospel questions, one way to act in faith is to:
choices: Wait until every question is answered
Stop going to church for a while
Only study with people who agree with you
questions.note: Also: rely on what you already know, and trust in the Lord.

rounds.title: Fake Out
rounds.intro: Write a believable fake ending, then find the real one.
rules: Your set of 3 or 4 gets one clue. Write a fake ending that sounds real.
Everyone else sees the real ending mixed in with the fakes and picks the one they trust.
Pick the real one and score. Fool a classmate with your fake and score every time.

rounds.title: Sketch It
rounds.intro: Draw a scripture story and guess your classmates' drawings.
rules: Your set draws the same story on your phone. No words or letters.
Everyone else sees the drawings and guesses which story it is.
Guess right and score. Draw clearly, because you score when classmates guess your story. Pick a favorite drawing for a bonus.

stories.story: Joseph fleeing and leaving his garment behind
A family choosing to serve the Lord together
God creating man in His own image
A husband and wife becoming one
A city of people with one heart and one mind, and no poor among them
Moses with the Ten Commandments on tablets of stone
Two sticks becoming one in a hand
A watchman on a tower warning the people
Scarlet sins becoming white as snow
Elijah appearing in the Kirtland Temple
Martin Harris showing characters from the gold plates to a scholar
The hearts of fathers and children turning toward each other
The windows of heaven opening to pour out blessings
Climbing the hill of the Lord with clean hands

rounds.title: The Final Question
rounds.intro: One hard question. Everything is on the line.
rules: Wager first, anywhere from nothing up to your whole score.
The question has five or six close choices, so read carefully.
Right: you win your wager. Wrong: you lose it. Audience members who answer correctly score too.

finals.q: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as ____.”
finals.note: Isaiah 1:18. Both halves promise cleansing through the Savior.
